summary: Queued pull requests that change different package files no longer conflict in `dist/`. The package provenance `dist/*/.agent-marketplace-package.json` no longer commits the shared build identity: schema 4 drops `build_id`, `source_ref`, `source_channel` and `source_commit`, and writes each file hash on a line of its own, so two changes to neighbouring files touch no adjacent lines. The deterministic snapshot `build_id` of the canonical sources is computed where it is needed: release preparation records it in `.release/stable.json`, the release replay reproduces it, `tools/release.py verify-release` recomputes it at a release commit, and the merge queue release gate lets only the release entry change it. Two queued PRs that change the same package file still conflict and are refreshed.
